Because conditioned emptiness is pure, the four applications of mindfulness are pure; because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Because whether it be the purity of conditioned emptiness, the purity of the four applications of mindfulness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because conditioned phenomena are empty and pure, the four right endeavors, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right endeavors up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of conditioned emptiness, the purity of the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because conditioned emptiness is pure, the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of conditioned phenomena, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.

Because conditioned phenomena are empty and pure, the gates of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure; because the gates of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of conditioned phenomena, the purity of the gates of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
"Subhūti! Because conditioned emptiness is pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the conditioned, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because conditioned emptiness is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If conditioned emptiness is pure, if the five eyes are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
Because conditioned emptiness is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of conditioned emptiness, the purity of the six supernormal powers, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because conditioned emptiness is pure, the ten powers of a Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If conditioned phenomena are pure, if the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because conditioned phenomena are empty and pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of conditioned emptiness, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because conditioned phenomena are pure in their emptiness, the qualities of non-forgetfulness are pure; because the qualities of non-forgetfulness are pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of conditioned phenomena (*saṃskṛta*), the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because conditioned phenomena are pure through emptiness, the state of constant equanimity is pure; because the state of constant equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the conditioned is pure, and if the nature of constant equanimity is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because conditioned phenomena are pure through emptiness, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is this?
If conditioned phenomena are pure, if all-knowledge is pure, and if the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because conditioned phenomena are empty and pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the conditioned is pure, the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because conditioned phenomena are empty and pure, all dhāraṇī gateways are pure; because all dhāraṇī gateways are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the conditioned is pure, the purity of all dhāraṇī-doors is pure, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
Because conditioned phenomena are empty and pure, all doors of samādhi are pure; because all doors of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the conditioned is pure, the purity of all doors of samādhi is pure, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because conditioned emptiness is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?

If conditioned phenomena are pure, if the fruit of stream-entry is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because conditioned phenomena are empty and pure, the fruit of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure; because the fruit of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of conditioned phenomena, the purity of the fruit of once-returning, non-returning, and arhatship, and the purity of all-knowledge are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because conditioned phenomena are empty and pure, the enlightenment of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the enlightenment of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the conditioned, the purity of the enlightenment of a pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because conditioned emptiness is pure, the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of conditioned emptiness, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of conditioned phenomena is pure, the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the conditioned is pure, the unsurpassed perfect enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Furthermore, Subhūti!
Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, form is pure; because form is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if form is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure; because feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and the purity of feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the eye base is pure; because the eye base is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, if the sense base of the eye is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because unconditioned emptiness is pure, the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and the purity of the spheres of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind is pure, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the sphere of form is pure; because the sphere of form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the sphere of form is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the bases of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure; because the bases of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the eye-faculty is pure; because the eye-faculty is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the eye-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the form element, the eye-consciousness element, eye-contact, and all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure; because the form element up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of unconditioned emptiness, the purity of everything from the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the ear-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the sound element, the ear-consciousness element, and ear-contact, as well as all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, are pure; because the sound element up to all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned (*asaṃskṛta-śūnyatā*), the purity of the sphere of sound (*śabda-dhātu*) up to the various feelings (*vedanā*) produced with ear-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the nose element is pure; because the nose element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, if the nose element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because unconditioned emptiness is pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned (*asaṃskṛta-śūnyatā*), the purity of the realm of fragrance up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the tongue-element is pure; because the tongue-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the tongue element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because unconditioned emptiness is pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the taste element—and indeed all sensations produced with tongue-contact as a condition—are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; for these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the body element is pure; because the body element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the body element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because unconditioned emptiness is pure, the sphere of tangibles, the sphere of body-consciousness, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of unconditioned emptiness, the purity of the sphere of tangibles up to the various feelings produced with body-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the unconditioned emptiness is pure, the mind-element is pure; because the mind-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the mind-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because unconditioned emptiness is pure, the dharma-element, the mind-consciousness element, and mental contact, as well as all feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, are pure; because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mental contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the unconditioned emptiness, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are without distinction, and they are uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the earth element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, and the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the purity of non-arising is pure; because the purity of non-arising is pure, the purity of the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the purity of the stainless is pure, and if the purity of the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, clinging, existence, birth, and old age, death, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, death, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the unconditioned emptiness, the purity of everything from formative activities up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of the perfection of generosity, and the purity of the knowledge of all aspects are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because unconditioned emptiness is pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline up to wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and the purity of the precepts up to the perfection of wisdom (*prajñāpāramitā*), and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñājñāna*), are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, internal emptiness is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, if internal emptiness is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned (*asaṃskṛta-śūnyatā*) is pure, there is purity of the emptiness of the external (*bahirdhā-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of both the internal and external (*adhyātma-bahirdhā-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of emptiness (*śūnyatā-śūnyatā*), the great emptiness (*mahā-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of the ultimate (*paramārtha-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of the conditioned (*saṃskṛta-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of the absolute (*atyanta-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of the limitless (*anavara-agra-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of dispersion (*anavakāra-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of non-alteration (*anavakāra-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of essential nature (*prakṛti-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of self-characteristics (*svalakṣaṇa-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of common characteristics (*sāmānya-lakṣaṇa-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of all phenomena (*sarvadharma-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of non-apprehensibility (*anupalambha-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of non-existence (*abhāva-śūnyatā*), the emptiness of intrinsic nature (*svabhāva-śūnyatā*), and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence (*abhāvasvabhāva-śūnyatā*). Because the emptiness of the external up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned (*asaṃskṛta-śūnyatā*), the purity of the emptiness of the external (*bahirdhā-śūnyatā*) up to the purity of the emptiness of the essential nature of non-existence (*abhāva-svabhāva-śūnyatā*), and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, if suchness is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because unconditioned emptiness is pure, the dharma-realm, the dharma-nature, the non-erroneous nature, the unchanging nature, the nature of equality, the nature of being free from birth, the fixedness of dharmas, the stability of dharmas, the limit of reality, the realm of space, and the inconceivable realm are pure; because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned (*asaṃskṛta*), the purity of the dharma-realm (*dharmadhātu*) up to the inconceivable realm (*acintyadhātu*), and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure; because the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the noble truth of suffering is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and not severed.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the Noble Truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure; because the Noble Truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the four dhyānas are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the eight liberations are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the unconditioned emptiness, the purity of the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten pervasive bases, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and there is no division between them.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the four applications of mindfulness are pure; because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of the four right endeavors up to the eightfold noble path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are without distinction, and they are uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the unconditioned emptiness, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are distinct neither in nature nor in continuity.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the gates of liberation of signlessness and wishlessness are pure; because the gates of liberation of signlessness and wishlessness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of the gateways to liberation of signlessness and wishlessness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the five eyes are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure. Why is this?

Because whether it be the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of the six supernormal powers, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the ten powers of a Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the unconditioned emptiness, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure; because the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if the nature of constant equanimity is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, and if all-knowledge is pure, and if the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path and the knowledge of all aspects, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, all dharani-doors are pure; because all dharani-doors are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of all dhāraṇī-doors, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.
Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, all gateways to samādhi are pure; because all gateways to samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of all doors of samādhi, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, if the fruit of stream-entry is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the fruit of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship is pure; because the fruit of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of unconditioned emptiness, the purity of the fruit of once-returning, non-returning, and arhatship, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the enlightenment of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the enlightenment of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of the awakening of a pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unconditioned is pure, the unsurpassed perfect enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed perfect enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unconditioned, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
"Furthermore, Subhūti!
Because ultimate emptiness is pure, form is pure; because form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If ultimate emptiness is pure, and if form is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure; because feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and the purity of feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness is the same as the purity of the knowledge of all modes; they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the eye-base is pure; because the eye-base is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Ultimate emptiness is pure, the eye base is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the spheres of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the spheres of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and the purity of the bases of ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind is identical to the purity of the knowledge of all modes; they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the sphere of form is pure; because the sphere of form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If ultimate emptiness is pure, and if the sphere of form is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, touch, and mental phenomena are pure; because the spheres of sound, odor, taste, touch, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, touch, and mental phenomena are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the eye-element is pure; because the eye-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Ultimate emptiness is pure, the eye-element is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the form realm (*rūpadhātu*), the eye-consciousness realm (*cakṣurvijñānadhātu*), eye-contact (*cakṣuḥsaṃsparśa*), and all feelings (*vedanā*) produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure. Because the form realm up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and the purity of everything from the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If ultimate emptiness is pure, if the ear-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the sound element, the ear-consciousness element, and ear-contact, as well as all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, are pure; because the sound element up to all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the nose-element is pure; because the nose-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Ultimate emptiness is pure, the nose element is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and the realm of fragrance up to the various sensations produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, and the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the tongue element is pure; because the tongue element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Ultimate emptiness is pure, the tongue-element is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and all sensations produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to all sensations produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and the purity of everything from the taste element up to the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
"Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the body element is pure; because the body element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Ultimate emptiness is pure, the body-element is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the sphere of tangibles, the sphere of body-consciousness, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and the feelings produced with contact as a condition—ranging from the element of contact up to the body—are pure, and the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the ultimate emptiness is pure, the mind-element (manodhātu) is pure; because the mind-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is this?
Ultimate emptiness is pure, the mind-element is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the dharma-element, the mental-consciousness-element, and mind-contact—as well as all feelings produced with mind-contact as their condition—are pure. Because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mind-contact as their condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and because everything from the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as a condition is pure, and because the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Ultimate emptiness is pure, the earth element is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be ultimate emptiness that is pure, or the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness that are pure, or the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) that is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, non-arising is pure; because non-arising is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of ultimate emptiness, the purity of signlessness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, grasping, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair are pure; because formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and the practice up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the perfection of giving is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline through wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and the purity of the precepts up to the perfection of wisdom, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, internal emptiness is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If ultimate emptiness is pure, if internal emptiness is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, external emptiness, internal-and-external emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, the emptiness of the ultimate truth, the emptiness of conditioned phenomena, the emptiness of unconditioned phenomena, the emptiness of the limitless, the emptiness of dispersion, the emptiness of non-alteration, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the emptiness of self-characteristics, the emptiness of common characteristics, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure; because external emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of ultimate emptiness, the purity of external emptiness up to the purity of the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of ultimate emptiness, the purity of suchness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the dharma-realm (*dharmadhātu*), the nature of phenomena (*dharmatā*), the non-erroneous nature, the unchanging nature, the nature of equality, the nature of freedom from birth, the fixedness of phenomena (*dharmaniyāmatā*), the stability of phenomena (*dharmaniveśanatā*), the limit of reality (*bhūtakoṭi*), the realm of space (*ākāśadhātu*), and the inconceivable realm are pure. Because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of ultimate emptiness, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure; because the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If ultimate emptiness is pure, if the noble truth of suffering is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure; because the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is this?
Ultimate emptiness being pure, the four dhyānas being pure, and the knowledge of all modes being pure—these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Ultimate emptiness is pure, the eight liberations are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; for they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten totalities are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten totalities are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten universal bases are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the four applications of mindfulness are pure; because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Ultimate emptiness is pure, the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the four right endeavors, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right endeavors up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of ultimate emptiness, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the gateways of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure; because the gateways of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of ultimate emptiness, the purity of the gateways to liberation of signlessness and wishlessness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of ultimate emptiness, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of ultimate emptiness, the purity of the five eyes, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of ultimate emptiness, the purity of the six supernormal powers, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

If ultimate emptiness is pure, if the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, and the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
"Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness that is pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness that is pure, and the knowledge of all modes that is pure, are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.
Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the state of constant equanimity is pure; because the state of constant equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If ultimate emptiness is pure, if the nature of constant equanimity is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is this?
Ultimate emptiness is pure, all-knowledge is pure, and the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure; for they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, and the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, all dhāraṇī gateways are pure; because all dhāraṇī gateways are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure."

Why is this? Because whether it be ultimate emptiness being pure, all dharani-doors being pure, or the knowledge of all modes of knowledge being pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because ultimate emptiness is pure, all doors of samādhi are pure; because all doors of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of ultimate emptiness, the purity of all gateways to samādhi, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If ultimate emptiness is pure, if the fruit of stream-entry is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure; because the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the fruit of once-returning, non-returning, and arhatship is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the enlightenment of the pratyekabuddhas is pure; because the enlightenment of the pratyekabuddhas is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness, the purity of pratyekabuddha-enlightenment, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be ultimate emptiness being pure, the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas being pure, or the knowledge of all modes being pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the unsurpassed, perfect enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed, perfect enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because ultimate emptiness is pure, the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, form is pure; because form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Because whether it be the purity of the emptiness of the limitless, the purity of form, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure; because feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness of phenomena, the purity of feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the eye-base is pure; because the eye-base is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the limitlessness of the ultimate is pure, and if the sense-field of the eye is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (*anavara-śūnyatā*), the purity of the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the sphere of form is pure; because the sphere of form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the limitlessness is pure, and if the sphere of form is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure; because the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness of phenomena, the purity of the spheres of sound, odor, taste, touch, and mental objects, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the eye-element is pure; because the eye-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the limit of reality is pure, and if the eye-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the form realm, the eye-consciousness realm, eye-contact, and all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure; because the form realm up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness of phenomena and the purity of everything from the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes, are non-dual; they are not two, they are undivided, they are without distinction, and they are not severed.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the emptiness of the limitlessness is pure, if the ear-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the sphere of sounds, the sphere of auditory consciousness, auditory contact, and all sensations produced with auditory contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of sounds up to all sensations produced with auditory contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (anavasthā-śūnyatā) and the purity of everything from the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the nose element is pure; because the nose element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the limit of reality is pure, if the nose element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (anavasthā-śūnyatā) and the purity of everything from the realm of fragrance up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the tongue-element is pure; because the tongue-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the limitlessness of phenomena is pure, and if the tongue-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and all sensations produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to all sensations produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (*anavarāgra-śūnyatā*) and the purity of all feelings arising from the condition of the taste element up to tongue-contact, as well as the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*), are non-dual; they are not two, they are undivided, they are distinct, and they are uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the body element is pure; because the body element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the limitlessness is pure, and if the body-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the sphere of tangibles, the sphere of body-consciousness, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (anavasthā-śūnyatā) and the purity of the sphere of tangibles (*spraṣṭavya-dhātu*)—up to and including the various feelings produced with body-tangibles as their condition—and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*), are non-dual; they are not two, they are without division, they are distinct, and they are uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the mind-element (*manodhātu*) is pure; because the mind-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the limitlessness of phenomena is pure, if the mind-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the dharma-element, the mental consciousness-element, and mind-contact, as well as all feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition, are pure; because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (anavasthā-śūnyatā) and the purity of everything from the dharma-realm (dharmadhātu) up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual; they are not two, they are undifferentiated, they are distinctless, and they are uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the limitless is pure, and if the earth element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of the limitlessness of phenomena is pure, and the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, and the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the purity of non-arising is pure; because the purity of non-arising is pure, the purity of the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the limit of reality is pure, if the emptiness of the beginningless is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, clinging, existence, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (anavasthā-śūnyatā) and the purity of everything from conditioned formations up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, as well as the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Suvikrāntavikrāmin!
Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness of phenomena, the purity of the perfection of generosity, and the purity of the knowledge of all aspects are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline up to wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (anavasthā-śūnyatā), the purity of the pure precepts up to the perfection of wisdom (prajñāpāramitā), and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the emptiness of the internal is pure; because the emptiness of the internal is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the limitlessness is pure, if the emptiness of the internal is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, there is purity of the emptiness of the external, the emptiness of the internal and external, the emptiness of emptiness, the great emptiness, the emptiness of the ultimate truth, the emptiness of the conditioned, the emptiness of the unconditioned, the absolute emptiness, the emptiness of dispersion, the emptiness of non-alteration, the emptiness of essential nature, the emptiness of self-characteristic, the emptiness of common characteristic, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence. Because the emptiness of the external up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (anavakāra-śūnyatā) and the purity of the emptiness of the external (bahirdhā-śūnyatā), up to the purity of the emptiness of the essential nature of non-existence (abhāva-svabhāva-śūnyatā), and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitlessness of phenomena is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the limitlessness is pure, and if suchness is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the dharma-realm (*dharmadhātu*), the dharma-nature (*dharmatā*), the non-falsity, the non-alteration, the equality, the state beyond birth, the fixedness of dharma, the stability of dharma, the limit of reality (*bhūtakoṭi*), the realm of space (*ākāśadhātu*), and the inconceivable realm are pure; because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (*anavasthā-śūnyatā*), the purity of the dharma-realm (*dharmadhātu*) up to the inconceivable realm (*acintyadhātu*), and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) are non-dual; they are not two, are without distinction, and are not severed.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure; because the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the limitlessness is pure, if the noble truth of suffering is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the Noble Truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure; because the Noble Truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (anavara-śūnyatā), the purity of the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the limitlessness of the infinite is pure, and if the four dhyānas are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (anavasthā-śūnyatā) and the purity of the four immeasurables (apramāṇa) and the four formless attainments (ārūpya-samāpatti), as well as the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual; they are not two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the limitlessness is pure, if the eight liberations are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten totalities are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten totalities are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the limitlessness (*anavakāra-śūnyatā*), the purity of the eight bases of mastery (*abhibhvāyatana*), the nine successive meditative attainments (*anupūrva-vihāra-samāpatti*), and the ten universal bases (*kṛtsnāyatana*), and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*), are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the four foundations of mindfulness are pure; because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the limitlessness is pure, if the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the limitless is pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this?
