Why is this? Because intrinsic nature is pure, the four right endeavors up to the eightfold noble path are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is pure through emptiness, the door of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the door of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because if all phenomena are pure and empty, and if the realm of fragrance up to the various sensations produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because all phenomena are empty and pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, grasping, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Because if all phenomena are pure and empty, and if [the factors] from practice up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because of the purity of external emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence, there is purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*).

Why is this? Because if all phenomena are pure and empty, and if everything from external emptiness up to the emptiness of non-existence and self-nature is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because all phenomena are pure through emptiness, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Why is this? Because whether it be the emptiness and purity of all phenomena, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of the unapprehendable is pure, internal emptiness is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the purity of internal emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the unapprehendable is pure, there is the purity of external emptiness, internal-and-external emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, boundless emptiness, dispersed emptiness, non-alteration emptiness, essential nature emptiness, self-characteristic emptiness, common characteristic emptiness, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence. Because the emptiness of external [phenomena] up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the purity of the emptiness of the external up to the emptiness of the non-existence of intrinsic nature, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of the unapprehendable is pure, and if suchness is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-apprehensibility is pure, the dharma-realm, the dharma-nature, the non-erroneous nature, the unchanging nature, the nature of equality, the nature of freedom from birth, the fixedness of dharmas, the stability of dharmas, the limit of reality, the realm of space, and the inconceivable realm are pure; because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure; because the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the noble truth of suffering, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-apprehensibility is pure, the Noble Truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure; because the Noble Truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the four dhyānas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.

Because the emptiness of the unapprehendable is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless attainments are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless attainments are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the eight liberations, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-apprehensibility is pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the four applications of mindfulness are pure; because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the emptiness of non-apprehensibility is pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are undivided, they are without distinction, and they are uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehension, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the gates of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure; because the gates of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the gateways to liberation of signlessness and wishlessness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are distinct from nothing, and they are uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehensibility is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the emptiness of non-apprehensibility is pure, and if the five eyes are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.
Because the emptiness of non-apprehensibility is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the purity of the six superknowledges, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the ten powers of a Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehension, the purity of the ten powers of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-apprehensibility is pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the emptiness of the unapprehendable is pure, the state of constant dwelling in equanimity is pure; because the state of constant dwelling in equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the unapprehendable is pure, if the state of constant equanimity is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of all-knowledge, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the unapprehendable is pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, all dharani-doors are pure; because all dharani-doors are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of all dhāraṇī-doors, and the purity of the knowledge of all aspects are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
Because the emptiness of non-apprehensibility is pure, all doors of samādhi are pure; because all doors of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of all gateways to samādhi, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the fruit of stream-entry, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of the unapprehendable is pure, the fruits of the once-returner, the non-returner, and the arhat are pure; because the fruits of the once-returner, the non-returner, and the arhat are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the fruit of once-returning, non-returning, and arhatship, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the enlightenment of a pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehensibility is pure, the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-apprehension is pure, the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are undivided, distinct, or discontinuous.
"Furthermore, Subhūti!
Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, form is pure; because form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the emptiness of non-existence is pure, and if form is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure; because feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are distinct neither in essence nor in continuity.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the eye-base is pure; because the eye-base is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the emptiness of non-existence is pure, and if the sense-base of the eye is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the sphere of form is pure; because the sphere of form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If there is purity of the emptiness of non-existence, and if there is purity of the sense-base of form, and if there is purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the bases of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure; because the bases of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the sense bases of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the eye-element is pure; because the eye-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If there is purity through the emptiness of non-existence, and if there is purity of the eye-element, and if there is purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the form element, the eye-consciousness element, eye-contact, and all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure; because the form element up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of the absence of intrinsic nature is pure, and if the ear-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the sphere of sound, the sphere of auditory consciousness, auditory contact, and all feelings produced with auditory contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of sound up to all feelings produced with auditory contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the nose-element is pure; because the nose-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the emptiness of intrinsic nature is pure, if the nose element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and all sensations produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to all sensations produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the realm of fragrance up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are undifferentiated, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the tongue-element is pure; because the tongue-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of intrinsic nature is pure, if the tongue element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature and the purity of the various feelings produced with the gustatory element as a condition, up to those produced with tongue-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the body-element (*kāyadhātu*) is pure; because the body-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of intrinsic nature is pure, and if the body element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the sphere of tangibles, the sphere of body-consciousness, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the sphere of tangibles up to the various feelings produced with body-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are distinct neither in essence nor in continuity.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the mind-element is pure; because the mind-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the emptiness of non-existence is pure, and if the mind-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the dharma-element, the mental-consciousness-element, and mind-contact, as well as all feelings produced with mind-contact as condition, are pure; because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mind-contact as condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of non-existence is pure, and if the earth element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, non-arising is pure; because non-arising is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of the emptiness of non-arising, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, clinging, becoming, birth, and old age, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature and the purity of everything from formations up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, as well as the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the perfection of generosity, and the purity of the knowledge of all aspects are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, not distinct, and not separate.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline through wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the emptiness of intrinsic nature is pure, and the purity of the precepts up to the perfection of wisdom, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes, are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, internal emptiness is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of internal emptiness, and the purity of all forms of emptiness—namely, the emptiness of the unconditioned, the emptiness of the ultimate, the emptiness of the limitless, the emptiness of dispersion, the emptiness of non-alteration, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the emptiness of specific characteristics, the emptiness of common characteristics, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the emptiness of self-nature, and the emptiness of the self-nature of non-existence—[are established], then because of the purity of external emptiness up to the emptiness of the self-nature of non-existence, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of external emptiness up to the purity of the emptiness of the essential nature of non-existence, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of suchness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the dharma-realm (*dharmadhātu*), the nature of phenomena (*dharmatā*), the non-erroneous nature, the unchanging nature, equality, the nature free from birth, the fixedness of phenomena (*dharmaniyāmatā*), the stability of phenomena (*dharmaniyāmatā*), the limit of reality (*bhūtakoṭi*), the realm of space (*ākāśadhātu*), and the inconceivable realm are pure. Because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure; because the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of intrinsic nature is pure, and if the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and not severed.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path are pure; because the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

The purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the four dhyānas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are undivided, they are distinct from one another, and they are uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the eight liberations, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten totalities are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten totalities are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten pervasive bases, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the four applications of mindfulness are pure; because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?

If there is purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and if there is purity of the four applications of mindfulness, and if there is purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the four right endeavors up to the eightfold noble path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the gateways to liberation of signlessness and wishlessness are pure; because the gateways to liberation of signlessness and wishlessness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of the gateways to liberation of signlessness and wishlessness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of self-nature, the purity of the ten stages of the bodhisattva, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of intrinsic nature is pure, and if the five eyes are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Because whether it be the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of the six supernormal powers, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the ten powers of a Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of intrinsic nature is pure, and if the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the qualities of non-forgetfulness are pure; because the qualities of non-forgetfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the purity of the state of constant equanimity is attained; because the state of constant equanimity is pure, the purity of the knowledge of all modes is attained. Why is this?

If the purity of the emptiness of non-existence, the purity of the nature of constant equanimity, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, undivided, distinctless, and uninterrupted.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledges is pure. Why is this?
The purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of all-knowledge, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of non-nature, the purity of the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, all dhāraṇī-doors are pure; because all dhāraṇī-doors are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of all dhāraṇī-doors, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual; they are not two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, all doors of samādhi are pure; because all doors of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of all gateways to samādhi, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the emptiness of intrinsic nature is pure, and if the fruit of stream-entry is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the fruit of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship is pure; because the fruit of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the fruits of the Once-returner, the Non-returner, and the Arhat, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the enlightenment of a pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the practice of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas is pure; because the practice of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

"Subhūti! Because the emptiness of non-existence is pure, the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.
"Furthermore, Subhūti!
Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, form is pure; because form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If intrinsic nature is pure, if form is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure; because feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the eye-base is pure; because the eye-base is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the eye base, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the spheres of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the sphere of form is pure; because the sphere of form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the sense-base of form, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure; because the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the spheres of sound, odor, taste, touch, and mental phenomena, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the eye-faculty is pure; because the eye-faculty is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If intrinsic nature is pure, if the eye-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the form element (*rūpadhātu*), the eye-consciousness element (*cakṣurvijñānadhātu*), eye-contact (*cakṣuḥsaṃsparśa*), and all feelings produced with eye-contact as condition are pure; because the form element up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñājñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of everything from the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the ear-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the sphere of sound, the sphere of auditory consciousness, and ear-contact, as well as all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, are pure; because the sphere of sound up to all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature and the purity of everything from the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the nose-element is pure; because the nose-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If intrinsic nature is pure, if the nose element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and all sensations produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to all sensations produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the sphere of fragrance up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and there is no division between them.
"Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the tongue element is pure; because the tongue element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If intrinsic nature is pure and empty, if the tongue-element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the taste element up to the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the body-element (kāyadhātu) is pure; because the body-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the body-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the sphere of tangibles, the sphere of body-consciousness, and body-contact, as well as all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition, are pure; because the sphere of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the sense-field of tangibles up to the various feelings produced with body-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, not distinct, and not separate.

“Subhūti! Because the intrinsic nature of the mind-element (*manodhātu*) is empty and pure, the mind-element is pure; because the mind-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the mind-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the dharma-element, the mental-consciousness-element, and mental contact, as well as all feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, are pure; because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mental contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the earth element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is pure by way of emptiness, non-arising is pure; because non-arising is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of non-arising, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, grasping, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of intrinsic nature, or the purity of [the links from] conditioned formations up to old age, death, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the perfection of generosity, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline up to wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the pure precepts up to the perfection of wisdom (*prajñāpāramitā*), or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñājñāna*), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is pure through emptiness, internal emptiness is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of internal emptiness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, there is the purity of outer emptiness, inner-and-outer emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, limitless emptiness, dispersed emptiness, non-altering emptiness, essential emptiness, emptiness of self-characteristics, emptiness of common characteristics, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the emptiness of non-existence, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence. Because of the purity of outer emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of external emptiness up to the emptiness of the non-existence of intrinsic nature, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of suchness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the dharma-realm, the dharma-nature, the non-erroneous nature, the unchanging nature, equality, the nature free from birth, the fixedness of dharmas, the stability of dharmas, the limit of reality, the realm of space, and the inconceivable realm are pure; because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure; because the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the Noble Truth of Suffering, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path are pure; because the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the noble truths of suffering, its origin, its cessation, and the path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the four dhyānas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the eight liberations, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature and the purity of the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, the ten universal bases, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are without division, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.

“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the four applications of mindfulness are pure; because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.

Because the emptiness of intrinsic nature is pure, the gateways of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure; because the gateways of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the gateways to liberation of signlessness and wishlessness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the purity of intrinsic nature is empty, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the five eyes, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
Because the emptiness of intrinsic nature is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the emptiness of intrinsic nature, the purity of the six supernormal powers, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the ten powers of a Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the ten powers of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, undivided, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is pure through emptiness, the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not severed.

Because the purity of intrinsic nature is the purity of the state of constant equanimity; because the purity of the state of constant equanimity is the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna). Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the nature of constant equanimity, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, undivided, distinctless, and uninterrupted.
"Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of all-knowledge, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, undivided, inseparable, and uninterrupted.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowing is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the knowledge of the paths and all-aspect knowledge, or the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, all dhāraṇī-doors are pure; because all dhāraṇī-doors are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of all dhāraṇī-doors, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, all gateways of samādhi are pure; because all gateways of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of all gateways of samādhi, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the fruit of stream-entry, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the fruit of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship is pure; because the fruit of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the fruit of once-returning, non-returning, and arhatship, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, not distinct, and not severed.
“Subhūti! Because intrinsic nature is empty and pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of intrinsic nature, the purity of the enlightenment of a pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because suchness is pure, the nose-element is pure; because the nose-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the nose element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because suchness is pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, and nose-contact, as well as all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition, are pure; because the fragrance element up to all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Because whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the sphere of fragrance up to the various sensations produced with nose-contact as a condition, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because suchness is pure, the tongue-element is pure; because the tongue-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?

Whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the tongue element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because suchness is pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

"Subhūti! Because suchness is pure, the body element (*kāyadhātu*) is pure; because the body element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the body-element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because suchness is pure, the sphere of tangibles, the sphere of body-consciousness, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the various feelings arising with the body as the basis and contact as the condition—up to the touch element—or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the purity of suchness, the sphere of mind (manodhātu) is pure; because the sphere of mind is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the mental element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because suchness is pure, the dharma-element, the mental-consciousness-element, and mind-contact, as well as all feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition, are pure; because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

"Subhūti! Because suchness is pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the earth element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because suchness is pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because true thusness is pure, non-arising is pure; because non-arising is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the stainless, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because suchness is pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, clinging, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of [the links of dependent origination] from formations up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because suchness is pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the perfection of generosity, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because suchness is pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline through wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the pure precepts up to the perfection of wisdom, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because suchness is pure, internal emptiness is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of internal emptiness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because suchness is pure, external emptiness, internal-and-external emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, boundless emptiness, dispersed emptiness, non-alteration emptiness, essential nature emptiness, self-characteristic emptiness, common characteristic emptiness, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure; because external emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of suchness, the purity of external emptiness up to the purity of the emptiness of the nature of non-existence, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because true suchness is pure, the dharma-realm is pure; because the dharma-realm is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the dharma-realm, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because suchness is pure, the nature of phenomena (*dharmatā*), the non-falsity of phenomena, the immutability of phenomena, the equality of phenomena, the state of being free from birth, the fixed nature of phenomena (*dharmaniyāmatā*), the stability of phenomena (*dharmasthititā*), the limit of reality (*bhūtakoṭi*), the realm of space (*ākāśadhātu*), and the inconceivable realm (*acintyadhātu*) are pure. Because the nature of phenomena up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of suchness, the purity of the dharma-nature up to the inconceivable realm, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because true suchness is pure, the noble truth of suffering is pure; because the noble truth of suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If suchness is pure, if the noble truth of suffering is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
