Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

Because whether it be the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of the five eyes, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-falsity, the purity of the six supernormal powers, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, undivided, distinctless, and uninterrupted.
"Subhūti! Because non-falsity is pure, the ten powers of a Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of the ten powers of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
"Subhūti! Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure; because the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of the nature of constant dwelling in equanimity, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because non-falsity is pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of all-knowledge, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of the knowledge of the paths and all-knowledge, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
"Subhūti! Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, all dharanī-doors are pure; because all dharanī-doors are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of all dhāraṇī-doors, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.
Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, all gateways to samādhi are pure; because all gateways to samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of all gateways of samādhi, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are distinct from nothing, and they are uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of the fruit of stream-entry, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure; because the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of the fruit of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
"Subhūti! Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of the awakening of a pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

"Subhūti! Because the nature of non-falsity is pure, the unsurpassed perfect enlightenment of all Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed perfect enlightenment of all Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-falsity, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Furthermore, Subhūti!
Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, form is pure; because form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of form, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, without division, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because non-alteration is pure, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure; because feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, undivided, distinctless, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the eye-base is pure; because the eye-base is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the eye-base, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the state of non-alteration is pure, the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the unchanging nature, the purity of the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the sphere of form is pure; because the sphere of form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the sense-sphere of form, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the bases of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure; because the bases of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of omniscience are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the eye-element is pure; because the eye-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the eye-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the state of non-alteration is pure, the form element (*rūpadhātu*), the eye-consciousness element (*cakṣurvijñānadhātu*), eye-contact (*cakṣuḥsaṃsparśa*), and all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure; because the form element up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of everything from the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
"Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the ear-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because of the purity of immutability, the sound element, the ear-consciousness element, and ear-contact, as well as all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, are pure; because the sound element up to all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because non-alteration is pure, the nose-element is pure; because the nose-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the nose element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, undivided, distinctless, and uninterrupted.

Because of the purity of non-alteration, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the unchanging nature, the purity of everything from the fragrance-element up to the various sensations produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the tongue-element is pure; because the tongue-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the tongue element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because non-alteration is pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the unchanging nature, the purity of the taste element up to the various sensations produced with tongue-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because non-alteration is pure, the body element (*kāyadhātu*) is pure; because the body element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the body element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the state of non-alteration is pure, the sphere of tangibles, the sphere of body-consciousness, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the sense-sphere of tangibles up to the various feelings produced with body-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

“Subhūti! Because the non-alteration of intentionality is pure, the mind-element (*manodhātu*) is pure; because the mind-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the mind-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the immutability of the dharma-realm is pure, the consciousness-element, the mind-contact, and all feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition are pure; because the dharma-realm up to all feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and there is no separation between them.
"Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the earth element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, without division, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because the purity of non-alteration is pure, the purity of non-arising is pure; because the purity of non-arising is pure, the purity of the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If there is purity of non-alteration, if there is purity of luminosity, and if there is purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, and uninterrupted.

Because of the purity of non-alteration, formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, grasping, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair are pure; because of the purity of formations up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of [the factors] from formations up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the perfection of generosity (*dānapāramitā*), and the purity of the knowledge of all aspects (*sarvajñājñāna*) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the state of non-alteration is pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline through wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the pure precepts up to the perfection of wisdom (*prajñāpāramitā*), and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñājñāna*) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, internal emptiness is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of internal emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the purity of non-alteration, outer emptiness, inner-and-outer emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, boundless emptiness, dispersed emptiness, emptiness of non-alteration, emptiness of essential nature, emptiness of specific characteristics, emptiness of common characteristics, emptiness of all phenomena, emptiness of the unapprehendable, emptiness of non-existence, emptiness of intrinsic nature, and emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure; and because the purity of outer emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of external emptiness up to the purity of the emptiness of the nature of non-existence, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of suchness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the dharma-realm, the dharma-nature, the nature of non-falsity, the nature of equality, the nature of being free from birth, the fixedness of dharmas, the stability of dharmas, the limit of reality, the realm of space, and the inconceivable realm are pure; because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure; because the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the Noble Truth of Suffering, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the state of non-alteration is pure, the Noble Truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure; because the Noble Truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the noble truths of suffering, its origin, its cessation, and the path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the four dhyānas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the immutability of nature is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the eight liberations, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are without distinction, and they are without interruption.

Because the state of non-alteration is pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten universal bases are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten universal bases are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten totalities, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the purity of non-alteration, the four foundations of mindfulness are pure; because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because non-alteration is pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the four right endeavors up to the eightfold noble path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the purity of non-alteration is pure, the emptiness gate of liberation is pure; because the emptiness gate of liberation is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

Because the purity of unchanging nature is [identical to] the purity of the signless and wishless doors of liberation, and because the purity of the signless and wishless doors of liberation is [identical to] the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*).

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the gates of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the five eyes, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
Because the immutability is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the six supernormal powers, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous; therefore, they are so.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the ten powers of the Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of the Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the ten powers of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

“Subhūti! Because the purity of non-alteration is [itself] pure, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness is [itself] pure; because the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness is [itself] pure, the purity of the knowledge of all aspects is [itself] pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and not severed.

Because the immutability is pure, the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure; because the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is this?
Because the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the state of constant equanimity, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of all-knowledge, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

Because the purity of immutability, the knowledge of the paths (*mārgajñatā*) and the knowledge of all aspects (*sarvākārajñatā*) are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path and the knowledge of all aspects, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, all dhāraṇī-doors are pure; because all dhāraṇī-doors are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of all dhāraṇī-doors, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, all gateways to samādhi are pure; because all gateways to samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of all gateways to samādhi, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of non-alteration, the purity of the fruit of stream-entry, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the fruits of the once-returner, the non-returner, and the arhat are pure; because the fruits of the once-returner, the non-returner, and the arhat are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the fruit of the Once-returner, the Non-returner, and the Arhat, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the enlightenment of a Pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the nature of non-alteration is pure, the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of non-alteration, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
"Furthermore, Subhūti!
Because the nature of equality is pure, form is pure; because form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of form, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure; because feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the eye-base is pure; because the eye-base is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the eye-base, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of suchness, the purity of the spheres of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
"Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the sphere of form is pure; because the sphere of form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of suchness, the purity of the sphere of form, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, touch, and mental phenomena are pure; because the spheres of sound, odor, taste, touch, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the spheres of sound, odor, taste, touch, and mental phenomena, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the eye-element is pure; because the eye-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the eye-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, undivided, distinctless, and uninterrupted.

Because equality is pure, the form element (*rūpadhātu*), the eye-consciousness element (*cakṣurvijñānadhātu*), and eye-contact (*cakṣuḥsaṃsparśa*), as well as all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, are pure. Because the form element up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.
"Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the ear-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because equality is pure, the sphere of sound, the sphere of auditory consciousness, auditory contact, and all feelings produced with auditory contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of sound up to all feelings produced with auditory contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the sphere of sound up to the various sensations produced with ear-contact as a condition, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the nose element is pure; because the nose element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the nose element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the realm of fragrance up to the various sensations produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the tongue-element is pure; because the tongue-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the tongue element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the taste element up to the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the body-element (kāyadhātu) is pure; because the body-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is that?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the body element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the element of tangibles, the element of body-consciousness, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure; because the element of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the sphere of tangibles up to the various feelings produced with body-tangibles as conditions, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Through the purity of equality, the sphere of mind (manodhātu) is pure; through the purity of the sphere of mind, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the mind-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, without division, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because equality is pure, the dharma-element, the mind-consciousness-element, and mental contact, as well as all feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, are pure; because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mental contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the earth element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because equality is pure, non-arising is pure; because non-arising is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of equality, the purity of non-duality, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because equality is pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, clinging, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of [the links of dependent origination] from formations up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the perfection of generosity, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because equality is pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline up to wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of pure ethical discipline up to the perfection of wisdom (*prajñāpāramitā*), or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*), these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because equality is pure, internal emptiness is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of internal emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, external emptiness, internal-and-external emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, boundless emptiness, dispersion emptiness, non-alteration emptiness, essential nature emptiness, self-characteristic emptiness, common characteristic emptiness, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure. Because external emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of external emptiness up to the purity of the emptiness of the non-existence of intrinsic nature, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of equality, the purity of suchness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because equality is pure, the dharma-realm (*dharmadhātu*), the nature of phenomena (*dharmatā*), non-falsity, immutability, the state beyond birth, the fixed nature of phenomena (*dharmaniyāmatā*), the stability of phenomena (*dharmasthititā*), the limit of reality (*bhūtakoṭi*), the realm of space (*ākāśadhātu*), and the inconceivable realm (*acintyadhātu*) are pure. Because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure; because the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the noble truth of suffering, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path are pure; because the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the four dhyānas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because equality is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the eight liberations, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, undivided, distinctless, and uninterrupted.

Because equality is pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten pervasive bases, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the four foundations of mindfulness are pure; because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of awakening, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the four right endeavors up to the eightfold noble path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the gateways of liberation of signlessness and wishlessness are pure; because the gateways of liberation of signlessness and wishlessness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the gateways of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of sameness, the purity of the five eyes, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because equality is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

Because whether it is the purity of equality, the purity of the six supernormal powers, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the ten powers of a Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the ten powers of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, undivided, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because equality is pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
Because equality is pure, the state of constant equanimity is pure; because the state of constant equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of equality, the purity of the state of constant equanimity, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is that?
If the purity of suchness, the purity of all-knowledge, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all-knowing is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path and the knowledge of all aspects, or the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, all dhāraṇī-doors are pure; because all dhāraṇī-doors are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of all dhāraṇī-doors, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because equality is pure, all gateways of samādhi are pure; because all gateways of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of all gateways of samādhi, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of suchness, the purity of the fruit of stream-entry, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because equality is pure, the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure; because the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the fruit of the once-returner, the non-returner, and the arhat, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the awakening of a pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because equality is pure, the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the nature of equality, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are distinct from one another, and they are not severed.
