Because the ten totalities (*daśakṛtsnāyatana*) are pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purification of the ten spheres of totality, the purification of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśa-kṛtsnāyatana*) are pure, the light of knowledge (*vidyā*) is pure; because the light of knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the ten totalities, the purity of the light of clarity, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, clinging, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure; because formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because if the ten spheres of totality are pure, if everything from formations up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the perfection of generosity, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline up to wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the pure precepts up to the perfection of wisdom, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśa kṛtsnāyatanāni*) are pure, internal emptiness (*adhyātma-śūnyatā*) is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of internal emptiness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśakṛtsnāyatana*) are pure, external emptiness, internal-and-external emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, boundless emptiness, dispersed emptiness, non-alteration emptiness, essential nature emptiness, self-characteristic emptiness, common characteristic emptiness, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure; because external emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of external emptiness up to the emptiness of the non-existence of intrinsic nature, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the ten spheres of totality are pure, if suchness is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśakṛtsnāyatana*) are pure, the dharma-realm (*dharmadhātu*), the nature of phenomena (*dharmatā*), non-falsity (*avitathatā*), non-alteration (*ananyathābhāva*), sameness (*samatā*), the state beyond birth (*anirodhatā*), the fixed nature of phenomena (*dharmaniyāmatā*), the stability of phenomena (*dharmasthititā*), the limit of reality (*bhūtakoṭi*), the realm of space (*ākāśadhātu*), and the inconceivable realm (*acintyadhātu*) are pure; because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purification of the ten spheres of totality, the purification of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the ten totalities (daśa-kṛtsnāyatana) are pure, the noble truth of suffering is pure; because the noble truth of suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure. Why is this?

If the ten spheres of totality are pure, if the noble truth of suffering is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure; because the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.

The Great Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra, Fascicle Two Hundred and Twenty-seven. Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Xuanzang by Imperial Decree. Part One: Chapter Thirty-four, "Difficult to Believe and Understand," Section Four. "Subhūti!
Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśa kṛtsnāyatana*) are pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the four dhyānas, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of the ten totalities, the purity of the eight liberations, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the ten totalities (*daśakṛtsnāyatana*) are pure, the eight bases of mastery (*aṣṭavimokṣāyatana*) and the nine successive attainments (*navānupūrvavihārasamāpatti*) are pure; because the eight bases of mastery and the nine successive attainments are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the eight bases of mastery and the nine successive attainments, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśa kṛtsnāyatanāni*) are pure, the four foundations of mindfulness (*catvāri smṛtyupasthānāni*) are pure; because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is that?

Whether it be the purity of the ten totalities, the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the ten totalities are pure, the door of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the door of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the door of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the doors of liberation of signlessness and wishlessness are pure; because the doors of liberation of signlessness and wishlessness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the doors of liberation of signlessness and wishlessness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśa kṛtsnāyatanāni*) are pure, the five eyes (*pañca cakṣūṃṣi*) are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure. Why is that?

Whether it be the purification of the ten totalities, the purification of the five eyes, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure. Why is this?

Because whether it be the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the six supernormal powers, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the ten powers of the Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of the Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the ten spheres of totality are pure, if the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes are pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśakṛtsnāyatana*) are pure, the four fearlessnesses (*caturvaiśāradya*), the four analytical knowledges (*catasraḥ pratisaṃvid*), great loving-kindness (*mahāmaitrī*), great compassion (*mahākaruṇā*), great sympathetic joy (*mahāmuditā*), great equanimity (*mahopekṣā*), and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha (*āveṇikabuddhadharma*) are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

“Subhūti! Because the ten totalities (daśakṛtsnāyatana) are pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness (asaṃpramoṣadharma) is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvākārajñatā) is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not divided.

Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure; because the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure. Why is this?

If the ten spheres of totality are pure, if the nature of constant equanimity is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the ten spheres of totality are pure, if all-knowledge is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purification of the ten spheres of totality, the purification of the knowledge of the aspects of the path and the knowledge of all aspects, and the purification of the knowledge of all-knowing wisdom are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.

“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśakṛtsnāyatana*) are pure, all doors of dhāraṇī are pure; because all doors of dhāraṇī are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of all doors of dhāraṇī, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, all doors of samādhi are pure; because all doors of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of all doors of samādhi, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

"Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśa kṛtsnāyatanāni*) are pure, the fruit of stream-entry (*srotāpattiphala*) is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure. Why is that?

If the ten spheres of totality are pure, if the fruit of stream-entry is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the ten totalities are pure, the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure; because the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the fruit of once-returning, non-returning, and arhatship, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the enlightenment of a pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality (*daśa kṛtsnāyatanāni*) are pure, the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the ten spheres of totality are pure, the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the ten spheres of totality, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
"Furthermore, Subhūti!
Because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, form is pure; because form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
If the purification of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purification of form, and the purification of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, feeling, perception, formations, and consciousness are pure; because feeling, perception, formations, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of feeling, perception, formations, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the eye base is pure; because the eye base is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purification of the sense base of the eye, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the sphere of form is pure; because the sphere of form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the sphere of form, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibles, and mental phenomena are pure; because the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibles, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the sense bases of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, distinct, or separate.
"Subhūti! Because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, the eye-element is pure; because the eye-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the eye-element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the form element, the eye-consciousness element, eye-contact, and all feelings produced with eye-contact as condition are pure; because the form element up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purification of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purification of everything from the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purification of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purification of the ear element, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the sound element, the ear-consciousness element, ear-contact, and all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure; because the sound element up to all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and there is no division between them.
“Subhūti! Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the nose element is pure; because the nose element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the nose element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of everything from the fragrance element up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are without distinction, and they are uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, the tongue element is pure; because the tongue element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?

Whether it be the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the tongue element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and all feelings produced with tongue-contact as condition are pure; because the taste element up to all feelings produced with tongue-contact as condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purification of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purification of the taste element up to the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition, and the purification of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
"Subhūti! Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the body element is pure; because the body element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the body element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the element of tangibles, the body-consciousness element, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure; because the element of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the element of contact up to the various feelings produced with body-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness is the purity of the mind-element (*manodhātu*); because the purity of the mind-element is the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*). Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the mind-element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the dharma-element, the mind-consciousness element, and mental contact, as well as all feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, are pure; because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mental contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purification of the earth element, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, non-arising is pure; because non-arising is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purification of the light of knowledge, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, grasping, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of everything from formations up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the perfection of generosity, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline through wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the pure precepts up to the perfection of wisdom, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, inner emptiness is pure; because inner emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of internal emptiness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, external emptiness, internal-and-external emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, boundless emptiness, dispersed emptiness, non-altering emptiness, essential emptiness, self-characteristic emptiness, common-characteristic emptiness, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure. Because external emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñājñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of outer emptiness up to the emptiness of non-existence of intrinsic nature, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the four applications of mindfulness are pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of suchness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the dharma-realm, the dharma-nature, the non-erroneous nature, the unchanging nature, equality, the state beyond birth, the fixedness of dharma, the stability of dharma, the limit of reality, the realm of space, and the inconceivable realm are pure; because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the noble truth of suffering is pure; because the noble truth of suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, the purity of the noble truth of suffering, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path are pure; because the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the five sense faculties, the purity of the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the nose-element is pure; because the nose-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?

Whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the nose element, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five faculties are pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the five sense faculties, the purity of the realm of fragrance up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the tongue element is pure; because the tongue element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the tongue element, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five faculties are pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to the feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the five sense faculties, the purity of the taste element up to the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the body element is pure; because the body element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the body element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the five faculties are pure, the sphere of tangibles, the sphere of body-consciousness, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure. Because the sphere of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because if the five sense faculties are pure, if the objects of touch up to the feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the mind-element (*manodhātu*) is pure; because the mind-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the mental constituent, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the five faculties are pure, the dharma-element, the mental-consciousness-element, and mind-contact, as well as all feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition, are pure. Because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the five sense faculties, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the earth element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five faculties are pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the light of wisdom is pure; because the light of wisdom is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the light of wisdom, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five faculties are pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, clinging, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the five faculties, or the purity of [the links from] formations up to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the perfection of generosity, and the purification of the knowledge of all aspects are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the five faculties are pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline up to wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the precepts up to the perfection of wisdom (*prajñāpāramitā*), or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñājñāna*), they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, inner emptiness is pure; because inner emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of internal emptiness, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five faculties are pure, there is purity of external emptiness, internal-and-external emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, boundless emptiness, dispersed emptiness, non-alteration emptiness, essential nature emptiness, self-characteristic emptiness, common characteristic emptiness, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence. Because there is purity from external emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence, there is purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna).

Why is this? Because the purity of the five sense faculties, the purity of external emptiness up to the emptiness of the non-existence of intrinsic nature, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of suchness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five faculties are pure, the dharma-realm, the dharma-nature, the non-falsity, the non-alteration, the equality, the nature free from birth, the fixedness of dharma, the stability of dharma, the limit of reality, the realm of space, and the inconceivable realm are pure. Because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowing, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure; because the Noble Truth of Suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the five faculties are pure, if the noble truth of suffering is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and not severed.

Because the five faculties are pure, the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path are pure; because the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the four dhyānas, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the five faculties are pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the eight liberations, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five faculties are pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten universal bases are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten universal bases are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, the ten universal bases, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the four foundations of mindfulness are pure; because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the five faculties are pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the four right efforts up to the eight branches of the noble path, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are without distinction, and they are not separate.

Because the five faculties are pure, the doors of liberation of signlessness and wishlessness are pure; because the doors of liberation of signlessness and wishlessness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the gates of liberation of signlessness and wishlessness, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the five eyes, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because the five faculties are pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the six supernormal powers, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the ten powers of the Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of the Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the five faculties, the purification of the Buddha’s ten powers, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five faculties are pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
"Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the dharma of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five faculties are pure, the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure; because the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure. Why is this?

If the five faculties are pure, if the state of constant equanimity is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of all-knowledge, or the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five faculties are pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path (*mārgākārajñatā*), the purity of the knowledge of all aspects (*sarvākārajñatā*), or the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge (*sarvajñajñāna*), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, all dharanī-doors are pure; because all dharanī-doors are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of all dhāraṇī-doors, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge (sarvajñajñāna), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because the five faculties are pure, all doors of samādhi are pure; because all doors of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of all doors of samādhi, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the fruit of stream-entry, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the five faculties are pure, the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure; because the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the fruit of once-returner, non-returner, or arhatship, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the five faculties, the purity of pratyekabuddha-enlightenment, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

“Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of the five faculties, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

"Subhūti! Because the five faculties are pure, the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the five faculties, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all aspects are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

If the purification of the five powers, the purification of the sense base of the eye, and the purification of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
Because the five powers are pure, the bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Because the five powers are pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure; because the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Because the five powers are pure, the form element, the eye-consciousness element, eye-contact, and all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure; because the form element up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the five powers, the purity of everything from the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the five powers are pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of the five powers, the purification of the ear element, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the five powers are pure, the sphere of sound, the sphere of ear-consciousness, ear-contact, and all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of sound up to all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the five powers, the purity of the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, not distinct, and not separate.

“Subhūti! Because the five powers are pure, the tongue-element is pure; because the tongue-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

“Subhūti! Because the five powers are pure, the body element is pure; because the body element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Because the purification of the five powers, the purification of the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition, and the purification of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
"Subhūti! Because the five powers are pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

"Subhūti! Because the five powers are pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure."

Why is this? Because the purity of the four analytical knowledges, the purity of the ten powers of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

Because great compassion is pure, external emptiness, internal-and-external emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, boundless emptiness, dispersed emptiness, non-alteration emptiness, essential nature emptiness, self-characteristic emptiness, common characteristic emptiness, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of non-apprehensibility, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure.
