Because great compassion is pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure; because the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the spheres of sound, odor, taste, touch, and mental phenomena, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the eye-element is pure; because the eye-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the eye-element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because great compassion is pure, the form element (*rūpadhātu*), the eye-consciousness element (*cakṣurvijñānadhātu*), eye-contact (*cakṣuḥsaṃsparśa*), and all feelings (*vedanā*) produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure; because the form element up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure.

Why is this? Because great compassion is pure, the various feelings arising from eye-contact as a condition up to the form realm are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the ear-element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great compassion is pure, the sphere of sound, the sphere of auditory consciousness, ear-contact, and all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of sound up to all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because great compassion is pure, and the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the nose element is pure; because the nose element is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure. Why is this?
If great compassion is pure, if the nose element is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because great compassion is pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because great compassion is pure, and the purity of the realm of fragrance up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the tongue-element is pure; because the tongue-element is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the tongue element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because great compassion is pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because great compassion is pure, and the purity of everything from the taste element up to the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the body-element is pure; because the body-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the body-element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because great compassion is pure, the sphere of tangibles, the sphere of body-consciousness, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because great compassion is pure, and the various feelings arising with the contact element as condition, up to those arising with body-contact as condition, are pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
"Subhūti! Because the great compassion is pure, the mind-element (*manodhātu*) is pure; because the mind-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the mental faculty, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great compassion is pure, the dharma-element, the mental-consciousness-element, and mind-contact, as well as all feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition, are pure; because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mind-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great compassion, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are indivisible, they are without distinction, and they are uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the earth element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great compassion is pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, non-arising is pure; because non-arising is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the knowledge of non-arising, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because great compassion is pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, clinging, existence, birth, and old age, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of [the links of dependent origination] from formations up to old age, death, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the perfection of giving is pure; because the perfection of giving is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the perfection of generosity, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great compassion is pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline up to wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the pure precepts up to the perfection of wisdom (*prajñāpāramitā*), or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, internal emptiness is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of internal emptiness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great compassion is pure, external emptiness, internal-and-external emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, boundless emptiness, dispersed emptiness, non-alteration emptiness, essential nature emptiness, self-characteristic emptiness, common characteristic emptiness, the emptiness of all phenomena, the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure. Because external emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because great compassion is pure, external emptiness up to the emptiness of the nature of non-nature is pure, and the knowledge of all modes is pure; these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of suchness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because great compassion is pure, the dharma-realm, the nature of phenomena, non-falsity, immutability, equality, the state beyond birth, the fixed nature of phenomena, the stability of phenomena, the limit of reality, the realm of space, and the inconceivable realm are pure; because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the noble truth of suffering is pure; because the noble truth of suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If great compassion is pure, if the noble truth of suffering is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and inseparable.

Because great compassion is pure, the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure; because the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the noble truths of origination, cessation, and the path, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
"Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the four dhyānas, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because great compassion is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not two distinct parts, without differentiation, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the eight liberations, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because great compassion is pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great compassion, the purity of the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten universal bases, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the four foundations of mindfulness are pure; because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because great compassion is pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the gate of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because great compassion, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because great compassion is pure, the gates of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure; because the gates of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because great compassion, the purity of the gateways to liberation of signlessness and wishlessness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.
"Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purification of great compassion, the purification of the five eyes, or the purification of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because great compassion is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the six supernormal powers, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the ten powers of a Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the ten powers of a Buddha, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because great compassion is pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great compassion, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure."

Why is this? Because great compassion, the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.

Because great compassion is pure, the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure; because the state of constant abiding in equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the state of constant dwelling in equanimity, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, all-knowledge is pure; because all-knowledge is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of all-knowledge, or the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because great compassion is pure, the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure; because the knowledge of the paths and the knowledge of all aspects are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path and the knowledge of all aspects, or the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, all dhāraṇī gateways are pure; because all dhāraṇī gateways are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of all dhāraṇī-doors, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.
Because great compassion is pure, all gateways of samādhi are pure; because all gateways of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of all doors of samādhi, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?

Whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of the fruit of stream-entry, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great compassion is pure, the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure; because the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great compassion, the purity of the fruit of once-returning, non-returning, and arhatship, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because great compassion, the purity of pratyekabuddha-enlightenment, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great compassion, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because great compassion is pure, the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because great compassion, the unsurpassed perfect enlightenment of the Buddhas, and the knowledge of all modes are pure; they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Furthermore, Subhūti!
Because great joy (*mahāmuditā*) is pure, form (*rūpa*) is pure; because form is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure. Why is this?..."
Whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of form, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great joy is pure, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure; because feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great joy, the purity of feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because great joy is pure, the sense base of the eye is pure; because the sense base of the eye is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?
Whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of the sense base of the eye, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.
Because great joy is pure, the bases of ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the bases of ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great joy, the purity of the spheres of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great joy is pure, the sphere of form is pure; because the sphere of form is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If great joy is pure, if the sphere of form is pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because great joy is pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure; because the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great joy, the purity of the spheres of sound, odor, taste, touch, and mental phenomena, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because great joy is pure, the eye-element is pure; because the eye-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of the eye-element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great joy is pure, the form element, the eye-consciousness element, and eye-contact, as well as all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, are pure; because the form element up to all feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great joy, the purity of everything from the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.
"Subhūti! Because great joy is pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of the ear-element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, these are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great joy is pure, the sound element, the ear-consciousness element, ear-contact, and all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure; because the sound element up to all feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great joy, the purity of the sphere of sound up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because great joy is pure, the nose-element is pure; because the nose-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of the nose element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because great joy is pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to all feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great joy, the purity of the fragrance element up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because great joy is pure, the tongue-element is pure; because the tongue-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of the tongue element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), these are non-dual, not divided into two, indistinguishable, and uninterrupted.

Because great joy is pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to all feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñājñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because great joy that is pure, the taste element up to the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition that are pure, and the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) that is pure, are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because great joy is pure, the body element is pure; because the body element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is that?

Whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of the body element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great joy is pure, the element of tangibles, the element of body-consciousness, body-contact, and all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure; because the element of tangibles up to all feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) is pure.

Why is this? Because if great joy is pure, if the sphere of tangibles and even the various feelings produced with body-contact as a condition are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
"Subhūti! Because great joy is pure, the mind-element (*manodhātu*) is pure; because the mind-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñājñāna*) is pure. Why is this?..."

Whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of the mind-element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of omniscience, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because great joy is pure, the dharma-element, the mental consciousness-element, and mental contact, as well as all feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, are pure; because the dharma-element up to all feelings produced with mental contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great joy, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because great joy is pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
Whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of the earth element, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because great joy is pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge (*sarvajñājñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because great joy is pure, non-duality is pure; because non-duality is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of great joy, the purity of great clarity, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because great joy is pure, volitional formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, clinging, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure; because volitional formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of great joy and the purity of everything from conduct through old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna), are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, not distinct, and not severed.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-knowledge, the purity of external emptiness up to the purity of the emptiness of the nature of non-nature, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because all-knowledge is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is this?
If all-knowledge is pure, if suchness is pure, and if the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because all-knowledge is pure, the dharma-realm, the nature of phenomena, the non-falsity of phenomena, the immutability of phenomena, the equality of phenomena, the state beyond birth, the fixedness of phenomena, the stability of phenomena, the limit of reality, the realm of space, and the inconceivable realm are pure; because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of all-knowledge, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, or the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because all-knowledge is pure, the noble truth of suffering is pure; because the noble truth of suffering is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is this?
If all-knowledge is pure, if the noble truth of suffering is pure, and if the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and not separate.

“Subhūti! Because all-knowledge is pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is this?

Why is this? Because whether it be the purity of all-knowledge, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, or the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-knowledge, the purity of the gateways to liberation of signlessness and wishlessness, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because all-knowledge is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of all-knowledge, the purity of the six supernormal powers, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because all-knowledge is pure, the ten powers of the Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of the Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure. Why is this?
If all-knowledge is pure, if the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, and if the knowledge of all modes is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because all-knowledge (*sarvajñatā*) is pure, the four fearlessnesses (*vaiśāradya*), the four analytical knowledges (*pratisaṃvid*), great loving-kindness (*maitrī*), great compassion (*karuṇā*), great sympathetic joy (*muditā*), great equanimity (*upekṣā*), and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha (*āveṇika-buddhadharma*) are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-knowledge, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

If all-knowledge is pure, if the state of constant equanimity is pure, and if the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because all-knowledge is pure, the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of all-knowledge, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, not distinct, and not separate.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of everything from the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, they are not separate, and they are not severed.

The purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the ear-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.

Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of external emptiness up to the purity of the emptiness of the essential nature of non-existence, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

The purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the four dhyānas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and there is no division between them.

If the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the eight liberations, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the ten stages of the bodhisattva, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the five eyes, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, these are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, nor discontinuous.

Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path results in the purity of the six superknowledges, and because the purity of the six superknowledges results in the purity of the knowledge of all aspects. Why is this?

Because whether it be the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the six superknowledges, or the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the ten powers of a Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

The purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the ten powers of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowing are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the quality of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the state of equanimity is pure; because the state of equanimity is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the state of constant equanimity, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
"Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the knowledge of all is pure; because the knowledge of all is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of all-knowledge, or the purity of the knowledge of all modes, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path results in the purity of the knowledge of all aspects; because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects results in the purity of the knowledge of all-knowing wisdom. Why is this?

Whether it be the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, or the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, all dharanī-doors are pure; because all dharanī-doors are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of all dharani-doors, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, all doors of samādhi are pure; because all doors of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of all doors of samādhi, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?

The purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the fruit of stream-entry, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.

Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the fruits of the once-returner, the non-returner, and the arhat are pure; because the fruits of the once-returner, the non-returner, and the arhat are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the fruits of the once-returner, the non-returner, and the arhat, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the awakening of a pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure; because the practices of all bodhisattva-mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of the aspects of the path is pure, the unexcelled, perfect enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure; because the unexcelled, perfect enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of the aspects of the path, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of all Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
"Furthermore, Subhūti!
Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, form is pure; because form is pure, the knowledge of all knowledge is pure. Why is this?"
If the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of form, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure; because feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect-knowledge, the purity of feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and there is no division between them.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the eye base is pure; because the eye base is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure. Why is that?
If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the sense-sphere of the eye, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure; because the bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the sense bases of the ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
"Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience is pure, the sphere of form is pure; because the sphere of form is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure. Why is this?

If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the sense-sphere of form, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibles, and mental phenomena are pure; because the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibles, and mental phenomena are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the spheres of sound, odor, taste, tangibility, and mental phenomena, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience is pure, the eye-element is pure; because the eye-element is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the eye-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the form realm, the eye-consciousness realm, eye-contact, and the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure; because the form realm up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience (*sarvākārajñatā*), the purity of everything from the form realm (*rūpadhātu*) up to the various feelings produced with eye-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not separate.
“Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience is pure, the ear-element is pure; because the ear-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the ear-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, indivisible, undifferentiated, and inseparable.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the sphere of sounds, the sphere of ear-consciousness, ear-contact, and the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure; because the sphere of sounds up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects (*sarvākārajñatā*), the purity of the sphere of sound (*śabdadhātu*) up to the various feelings produced with ear-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the nose element is pure; because the nose element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of the nose element, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, undivided, distinctless, and uninterrupted.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the fragrance element, the nose-consciousness element, nose-contact, and the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure; because the fragrance element up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience (*sarvākārajñatā*), the purity of the realm of fragrance up to the various feelings produced with nose-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience is pure, the tongue element is pure; because the tongue element is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the tongue element, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, undivided, distinctless, and uninterrupted.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the taste element, the tongue-consciousness element, tongue-contact, and the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure; because the taste element up to the various feelings produced with tongue-contact as a condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects (*sarvākārajñatā*), the purity of the taste element (*rasadhātu*) up to the various feelings (*vedanā*) produced with tongue-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual; they are not two, not divided, distinct, or discontinuous.

The Great Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra, Fascicle Two Hundred and Thirty-nine. Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Xuanzang by Imperial Decree. Part One: Chapter Thirty-four, "Difficult to Believe and Understand," Section Five of Nine. "Subhūti!
Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the body element is pure; because the body element is pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because whether it is the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the body element, or the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge, they are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the sphere of tangibles, the consciousness of body, body-contact, and the various feelings produced with body-contact as condition are pure; because the sphere of tangibles up to the various feelings produced with body-contact as condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect knowledge (*sarvākārajñatā*), the purity of the sphere of tangibles (*spraṣṭavyadhātu*) up to the various feelings produced with body-contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*), are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.

“Subhūti! Because the intentionality of the omniscience of all aspects (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure, the mind-element (*manodhātu*) is pure; because the mind-element is pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the mind-element, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the dharma-element, the mind-consciousness element, mental contact, and the various feelings produced with mental contact as condition are pure; because the dharma-element up to the various feelings produced with mental contact as condition are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the feelings produced with mental contact as a condition, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not divided into two, they are not distinct, and they are not discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience is pure, the earth element is pure; because the earth element is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the earth element, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure; because the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness are pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the elements of water, fire, wind, space, and consciousness, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or discontinuous.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, non-arising is pure; because non-arising is pure, the knowledge of all knowledge is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of non-duality, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, formations, consciousness, name-and-form, the six sense bases, contact, feeling, craving, grasping, becoming, birth, and old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure; because formations through to old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect-knowledge (*sarvākārajñatā*), the purity of [the factors] from practice through old age, death, sorrow, lamentation, suffering, grief, and despair, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.
“Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience is pure, the perfection of generosity is pure; because the perfection of generosity is pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of the perfection of generosity, and the purity of the knowledge of all aspects are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the perfections of ethical discipline, patience, diligence, meditative concentration, and wisdom are pure; because the perfections from ethical discipline through wisdom are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of the pure precepts up to the perfection of wisdom, and the purity of the knowledge of all aspects are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience is pure, internal emptiness is pure; because internal emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of internal emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the knowledge of all aspects (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure, external emptiness, internal-and-external emptiness, the emptiness of emptiness, great emptiness, ultimate emptiness, conditioned emptiness, unconditioned emptiness, absolute emptiness, boundless emptiness, dispersion emptiness, non-alteration emptiness, essential nature emptiness, self-characteristic emptiness, common characteristic emptiness, the emptiness of all phenomena (*sarvadharmaśūnyatā*), the emptiness of the unapprehendable, the emptiness of non-existence, the emptiness of intrinsic nature, and the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure; because external emptiness up to the emptiness of the intrinsic nature of non-existence are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of external emptiness up to the purity of the emptiness of non-existence of intrinsic nature, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience is pure, suchness is pure; because suchness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of suchness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the dharma-realm, the dharma-nature, the non-falsity, the non-alteration, the sameness, the state beyond birth, the fixedness of dharmas, the stability of dharmas, the limit of reality, the realm of space, and the inconceivable realm are pure; because the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm are pure, the knowledge of all modes of knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect knowledge, the purity of the dharma-realm up to the inconceivable realm, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge are non-dual; they are not two, they are not divided, they are not distinct, and they are not severed.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the noble truth of suffering is pure; because the noble truth of suffering is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect-knowledge, the purity of the noble truth of suffering, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual; they are not two, not distinct, and not separate.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure; because the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the noble truths of origin, cessation, and the path, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the four dhyānas are pure; because the four dhyānas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the four dhyānas, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure; because the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the four immeasurables and the four formless absorptions, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience is pure, the eight liberations are pure; because the eight liberations are pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of the eight liberations, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure; because the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive attainments, and the ten totalities are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of the eight bases of mastery, the nine successive meditative attainments, and the ten universal bases, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes of knowledge, are non-dual; they are not two, they are not distinct, and there is no division between them.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the four foundations of mindfulness are pure; because the four foundations of mindfulness are pure, the knowledge of all knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of the four foundations of mindfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the knowledge of all aspects (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure, the four right efforts, the four bases of power, the five faculties, the five powers, the seven factors of awakening, and the eightfold noble path are pure; because the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience (*sarvākārajñatā*), the purity of the four right efforts up to the eightfold noble path, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the door of liberation that is emptiness is pure; because the door of liberation that is emptiness is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect-knowledge, the purity of the gate of liberation that is emptiness, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the gateways of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure; because the gateways of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the gateways of liberation—signlessness and wishlessness—and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure; because the ten stages of the bodhisattva are pure, the knowledge of all-knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the ten stages of a bodhisattva, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience (*sarvākārajñatā*) is pure, the five eyes are pure; because the five eyes are pure, the knowledge of all modes (*sarvajñajñāna*) is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the five eyes, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, undivided, distinctless, and uninterrupted.
Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the six supernormal powers are pure; because the six supernormal powers are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the six supernormal powers, and the purity of the knowledge of all knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because all-aspect omniscience is pure, the ten powers of a Buddha are pure; because the ten powers of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all aspects is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the ten powers of a Buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the four fearlessnesses, the four analytical knowledges, great loving-kindness, great compassion, great sympathetic joy, great equanimity, and the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure; because the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a Buddha are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the four fearlessnesses up to the eighteen unique qualities of a buddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure; because the quality of non-forgetfulness is pure, the knowledge of all knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the state of non-forgetfulness, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.

Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects is the purity of the state of constant equanimity; because the purity of the state of constant equanimity is the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge. Why is this?
If the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of the nature of constant equanimity, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the knowledge of all is pure; because the knowledge of all is pure, the knowledge of the knowledge of all is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of all-knowledge, and the purity of the knowledge of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the knowledge of the paths is pure; because the knowledge of the paths is pure, the knowledge of all-knowing is pure. Why is this?
If the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the knowledge of the paths, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, all dharanī-doors are pure; because all dharanī-doors are pure, the knowledge of all knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of all dharani-doors, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, all doors of samādhi are pure; because all doors of samādhi are pure, the knowledge of all knowledge is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect omniscience, the purity of all doors of samādhi, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and uninterrupted.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the fruit of stream-entry is pure; because the fruit of stream-entry is pure, the knowledge of all knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of all-aspect-knowledge, the purity of the fruit of stream-entry, and the purity of the knowledge of all modes are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure; because the fruits of once-returner, non-returner, and arhatship are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the fruit of once-returning, non-returning, and arhatship, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.
“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure; because the awakening of a pratyekabuddha is pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the enlightenment of a pratyekabuddha, and the purity of the knowledge of all knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the practices of all bodhisattva mahāsattvas are pure; because the practices of all bodhisattva mahāsattvas are pure, the knowledge of all modes is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of all the practices of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, without distinction, and without interruption.

“Subhūti! Because the knowledge of all aspects is pure, the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure; because the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas is pure, the knowledge of all knowledge is pure.”

Why is this? Because the purity of the knowledge of all aspects, the purity of the unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment of the Buddhas, and the purity of the knowledge of all-knowledge are non-dual, not divided into two, distinct, or separate.
"Furthermore, Subhūti!
